extraction_notes: PREPARE offline sample only. Three final bodies are exact byte copies. No prior experiment artifact is modified.
Notes are explicit reviewed candidate annotations, not automatic semantic extraction, accepted Canon, independent human review, human Gold, reader/market evidence or formal Workflow certification.
Chapter1/2 notes do not export hidden true values or infer character UNKNOWN from unprovided Writer input. Private author-side knowledge/sources are preserved.
Chapter3 truth visibility requires the explicit revealed_facts body evidence. A scheduled chapter boundary alone does not establish actual acquisition or authorize disclosure.
Each changed note and each typed operation has one current-body Unicode half-open span; unchanged notes are carried. Ending includes the exact final paragraph and trailing newline.

Initial and sequential baseline hashes are canonical_bytes(FactBaseline.to_dict()) hashes. Deltas are existing PROPOSED_DELTA objects and previewed only with registered extensions and user-authorized-local-preview-not-commit.
Original delta evidence_ref values remain historical references. Current copied body hash plus exact quote spans are the local replay evidence, not proof that historical APIs or CI ran again.

Chapter2 original WRITER_NOTES_V1 and chapter3 original WRITER_NOTES_V1 are provenance only and must not supply current notes; chapter3 final review is V1 review plus exact revision plus V2 narrow check.
No large Writer Context, base64 Contract, reviewer-only baseline, full author hidden input or source_key material is copied. No secret-scanner exclusions or thresholds are changed.

Historical belief retention is distinguished from current narrative stance; a new true acquisition does not claim automatic old-belief deletion. Received material is distinguished from reading, agreement and acceptance.
